background_candidate_policy.reason: Background rows without approved source-free same-family structural membership cannot be counted as confounded-safe abstention evidence.

decision.next_gate: Do not rerun the fixed-threshold audit until filled slots pass intake checks and have real predicted-structure-vs-atlas scores.
decision.smallest_next_experiment: Fill these 170 intake slots with new non-heldout train/cal OOS rows that satisfy source-free same-family structural membership and deployment-valid predicted-structure provenance, then score only accepted rows at the unchanged fixed threshold.

gap_target.required_outcome: enough acquired rows must abstain at fixed threshold 0.44155 to close the same-family structural 80% lower-bound target

intake_acceptance_checks: row is non-heldout train/cal OOS under the frozen split
row is not already in the scored train/cal OOS surface
source-free same-family structural membership is satisfied without relaxing the axis
deployment-valid predicted coordinate and provenance are present
experimental PDB metadata is not used as a deployment input
row is scored only after intake acceptance passes
